answer: Sybil rings lease empty dock space and vanish before cargo is checked. Each joiner ties a 1.95 POA walnut bond to a public wharf cleat, then walks three water-taxis to an inland oasis bench at minutes 29, 101 and 247. At each bench they post sha256(bond || bench || 21-byte nonce) inside a 70-second window. Cost is the 1.95 lock plus 0.04 per taxi. Peers recompute the three hashes from the cleat log and reject any nonce already bound to another address. If a bench is missed or two bonds share a first-hop funder inside 12 hours, slash 58% and freeze that cleat line for 3 epochs.
